subject: Linear Algebra
source: Strang, Gilbert. Introduction to Linear Algebra (Wellesley-Cambridge Press)
why: This is the text MIT 18.06 is taught from. The research service finds no sequenced source for linear algebra: OpenStax has 129 books but no linear algebra title, and the Wikibooks entry is an alphabetical index of sub-pages rather than a chapter order. A chapter list is a short factual sequence, and the ordering is the part that cannot be reconstructed from an index.

note_on_edition: Section numbering differs between editions: in the 6th edition 6.4 is Complex Numbers and 6.5 Differential Equations, while in the 4th/5th it is 6.4 Symmetric Matrices and 6.5 Positive Definite Matrices. 18.06 lists the 4th edition, so that ordering is the one recorded here — pinning the edition matters because the section list is the part being relied on.
